Source._comment: Which client's extractor to run (see WyzeSalesExtract/Extraction). Optional - defaults to "WCSA" when left out entirely, so this section can just be deleted for a WCSA-pattern client's config rather than filled in.

Supabase._comment: Use the Session-mode pooler connection string from Supabase's project settings (Database > Connection string). ClientCode identifies which row in the clients table this data belongs to - created automatically on first run if it doesn't already exist.

Schedule._comment: 24-hour times, server local time. Add/remove entries as needed - the running service picks up changes to this list without needing a restart, except a change only takes effect once the currently-awaited run fires (restart the service for an immediate change). Runs whether or not anyone is logged in, once installed as a service - see README.

FiscalYear._comment: Leave OverrideYear null to auto-compute (Jan/Feb belong to the fiscal year that started the previous March; Mar-Dec belong to the fiscal year ending next Feb).

DataWindow._comment: Optional - leave EarliestLoadDate null (the default) for a client with no separate prior extract to protect, like WCSA. Set it only when onboarding a client from an already-verified prior extract (see README 'Adding a new client' step 5) - e.g. Edgetec's is "2026-09-07", the first date NOT already covered by its prior verified data. Once set, no run can ever delete or overwrite anything before this date.
